experimental_topic.meaning: An observable careful act of comparison and evidence inspection; no claim of actual intelligence.

chosen_concept.title_ko: 겹쳐진 해안선의 차이를 읽는 지도 연구자
chosen_concept.description: A newly authored adult map researcher at a dusk archive light table compares a transparent traced coastline with a cream paper map; a small inlet visibly deviates.

reference_scope.observed: Dark short bob, fine fringe, soft facial contours, deep brown eyes and natural lip shape.
reference_scope.scope: Visible face and hair only. Age, job, personality, body, clothing, scene and intelligence are authored or unassessed.

one_frame_observable_criteria.criterion: A visible portrait subject with reference-guided face and dark short bob/fine fringe.
one_frame_observable_criteria.source: test method plus coordinator reference scope

one_frame_observable_criteria.criterion: A concrete photographic scene containing visible activity rather than an abstract label.
Two distinct material layers form a legible comparison: paper map and transparent traced sheet.
Coastlines visibly coincide then differ at a discernible inlet, and the person directs gaze there.
One hand supports the paper and the other visibly grips the transparent sheet with plausible contact and distinct anatomy.
The scene reads as attentive comparison through the relation among subject, material layers and discrepancy; intelligence itself is unassessed.
The face, hands and compared contour remain within a readable photographic hierarchy; quiet presence is assessed separately from fidelity.

controls.settings: Saved sensual=1, fetish=0, creativity=1, surreal=0, auto→sensual_led; no overrides.

evaluation_rule: partial_is_fail for full experiment-gate success; absent output leaves pixels and impression unassessed; audit PASS is not render or artistic proof.
